Formula 1

Max. Red Bull.
And the whole package.

I follow Max Verstappen and Red Bull. Beyond the racing, I’m interested in the trade-offs around development rules and whole-car performance—and the decisions teams make about their drivers.

Macro & geopolitics

Big shifts.
Everyday prices.

I’m following the connection between oil prices, chip supply, and what we pay for technology. Especially DRAM and SSDs: how do supply pressures change the expectation that better technology should get cheaper?
